title: NVlabs/GR00T-WholeBodyControl
abstract:
Welcome to GR00T Whole-Body Control (WBC)! This is a unified platform for developing and deploying advanced humanoid controllers. This includes: Decoupled WBC models used in NVIDIA Isaac-Gr00t, Gr00t N1.5 and N1.6 and GEAR-SONIC

[ ](LICENSE) [ ](https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacLab/releases/tag/v2.3.2) [ ](https://nvlabs.github.io/GR00T-WholeBodyControl/) [ ](https://nvlabs.github.io/GEAR-SONIC/demo.html) --- # GR00T-WholeBodyControl This is the codebase for the **GR00T Whole-Body Control (WBC)** projects. It hosts model checkpoints and scripts for training, evaluating, and deploying advanced whole-body controllers for humanoid robots. We currently support: - **Decoupled WBC**: the decoupled controller (RL for lower body, and IK for upper body) used in NVIDIA GR00T [N1.5](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/gr00t-n1_5/) and [N1.6](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/gr00t-n1_6/) models; - **GEAR-SONIC Series**: our latest iteration of generalist humanoid whole-body controllers (see our [whitepaper](https://nvlabs.github.io/GEAR-SONIC/)); - **MotionBricks**: a real-time latent generative model for interactive motion control in animation and robotics (see the [project page](https://nvlabs.github.io/motionbricks/)). ## News - **[2026-07-23]** **SONIC v1.1 checkpoint** — released a robot-heading-normalized SONIC controller trained with wrist-pose augmentation for 3-point teleoperation and SONIC-backed VLA execution. See the [Model Card](#model-card) and [Download Models](https://nvlabs.github.io/GR00T-WholeBodyControl/getting_started/download_models.html#sonic-v11-checkpoint). - **[06/16]** **Isaac Teleop Setup (CloudXR / DeviceIO, in-process)** — added bring-up docs for the in-process CloudXR path via `isaacteleop[cloudxr]`, with no separate publisher container. See [Isaac Teleop Setup](https://nvlabs.github.io/GR00T-WholeBodyControl/tutorials/isaac_teleop_publisher_setup.html). - **[2026-06-16]** **Low-latency teleoperation checkpoint** — released a SONIC checkpoint with 4-frame SMPL reference lookahead for more responsive whole-body teleoperation. See the [Model Card](#model-card), [Download Models](https://nvlabs.github.io/GR00T-WholeBodyControl/getting_started/download_models.html#low
abstract_zh: 欢迎使用GR00T全身控制（WBC）！这是一个用于开发和部署先进人形控制器的统一平台。包括：NVIDIA Isaac-Gr00t、Gr00t N1.5和N1.6以及GEAR-SONIC中使用的解耦WBC模型。本代码库支持训练、评估和部署人形机器人的全身控制器，目前提供：解耦WBC（下半身强化学习，上半身逆运动学）、GEAR-SONIC系列通用人形全身控制器，以及MotionBricks实时潜在生成模型。最新进展包括端到端VLA工作流、交互式网页演示等。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出GR00T Whole-Body Control统一平台，集成了解耦式WBC（RL控制下半身+IK控制上半身）、通用全身控制器GEAR-SONIC系列以及实时潜空间生成模型MotionBricks，覆盖训练、评估和部署全流程。


# 一、动机

> 人形机器人全身控制缺乏统一的开发与部署平台，现有控制器往往将上下半身割裂或难以泛化，无法支撑从仿真到真实世界的快速迭代。


# 二、方法

> 提出GR00T Whole-Body Control统一平台，集成了解耦式WBC（RL控制下半身+IK控制上半身）、通用全身控制器GEAR-SONIC系列以及实时潜空间生成模型MotionBricks，覆盖训练、评估和部署全流程。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 发布了SONIC v1.1检查点，支持基于腕部姿态增强的3点遥操作；通过4帧SMPL参考前瞻实现低延迟全身遥操作，有效提升响应速度。


# 四、对我的启发

> 该平台将生成式模型与强化学习结合用于全身控制，但硬件泛化性和不同机器人形态的适配仍是挑战；与课题直接相关，可借鉴其解耦控制与生成式运动先验的设计思路。
